name: PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk
summary: PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk, an investment holding company, together with its subsidiaries, operates in coal mining infrastructure in Indonesia. The company operates Coal Mining, Port Services, and Mining services and Others segments. It offers coal-mining facilities, including overland conveyors, coal crushers, coal processing plants, coal stockpiles, and coal handling ports. The company also engages in the exploration, production, provision, and infrastructure of coal mining; investment activity; general trading services; and management consultancy services. The company was formerly known as PT Benakat Integra Tbk and changed its name to PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk …
